current_answer: If the target screen or intended user outcome is unclear, write that brief before choosing a design skill. OpenAI Product Design Ideate explicitly waits for its Get Context brief gate before making images. Once the target is clear, Ideate is a conditional choice for comparing three image directions before building; it is not a fix for small edits to an existing UI. For an existing system, supply its tokens, components, route, and required states. No listed skill has a pool-run result comparison against a careful no-skill brief.
